verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents its own code steps: Node.js can run at any point of a workflow, Python, Go and Bash are also supported, and `$.export` creates named exports from a step. That gives code-based transformation of data between steps. However, the evidence never shows an ops-friendly expression or formula syntax, or how later steps reference earlier step outputs when mapping fields. Missing for 10: an expression/formula language for mapping fields in pre-built actions, documentation of referencing prior step exports in later steps, and independent hands-on corroboration of data mapping.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can map and transform data between steps with expressions, functions, or formulas

citations.quote: Pipedream supports writing Node.js v at any point of a workflow. Anything you can do with Node.js, you can do in a workflow.
The $.export creates a named export with the given value.
you can use pre-built components when you're performing common actions, but you can write custom code when you need to.
